question: Magnesium oxide is formed when magnesium is burnt in the presence of air. Select the type of reaction involved in this.
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Oxidation reaction**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When **magnesium is burnt in the presence of air (oxygen), it reacts with oxygen to form magnesium oxide (*MgO*). **
 
• The chemical reaction is:2Mg+O2​→2MgO
 
• **Oxidation reaction**:
